price_timing: POST_FINAL — closing prices captured after every game ended. Used for EV-at-close EVALUATION ONLY. No selection here was ever a pregame play, and none is presented as one.
firewall: the board's EST Score / EST Line columns are ANOTHER MODEL's predictions. Not transcribed, not ingested, not compared against, not used to adjust anything.
HEADLINE: The market beat every model arm by a wide margin on this slate. V13 Brier 0.235-0.246 against a closing-line Brier of 0.185-0.190. The model's probabilities have roughly ONE THIRD the spread of the market's, so where it disagreed most it was most wrong.

cohorts_graded_separately_never_pooled.reading: v2 (stale form) outscored v3 (fresh form) 8-3 vs 7-4. That is NOISE at n=11 and is NOT evidence that stale form is better. The prospective ablation already found form freshness has no detectable accuracy effect, and one slate cannot overturn or confirm that. Reporting v2 as the 'winner' would be exactly the error this program exists to avoid.
cohorts_graded_separately_never_pooled.power: n=11 (10 for v1). No cohort difference here is distinguishable from chance. These grades are LEDGER MAINTENANCE, not evidence of skill.

THE_DISCRIMINATION_PROBLEM_QUANTIFIED.consequence: V13 prices an 11-game slate inside a 9.5pp band while the market spans 43pp. Every strong market opinion therefore registers as a large model 'edge' — not because the model found something, but because it has no mechanism to be confident. This is the standing 'discrimination is the binding constraint' finding, now measured against real closing prices rather than inferred.

EV_AT_CLOSE_EVALUATION_ONLY.WHY_THE_PROFIT_IS_NOT_EVIDENCE: its composition is the opposite of an edge. Split by the sign of the claimed edge:
EV_AT_CLOSE_EVALUATION_ONLY.verdict: ALL of the +1.058u came from games the model had NEGATIVE edge on — bets a value rule would never place. The games it actually liked went 3-3 and LOST money, and the two it liked most went 0-2. A slate that looks profitable on the bottom line is a losing slate for the strategy that would have been run.
EV_AT_CLOSE_EVALUATION_ONLY.LAD_at_COL_the_clearest_case: model 50.8% COL vs market 27.3% — a 23.5pp disagreement claiming +0.829 EV per unit. COL lost 5-11. The model had no COL-specific information; it simply cannot express 27%.

TOTALS.reading: V13 ran LOW by ~1.1 runs on average with a 3.7-run mean absolute error. On an 8-11 run slate that is not a usable totals signal.
